# 3L5S / 三层五步

## 这是什么

3L5S 是 `Three Layers + Five Steps`，中文叫“三层五步”。它是一套通用问题处理内核，用来把混乱现象收敛成可复述、可定位、可证伪、可执行的任务。

![3L5S 架构示意图：外层三层大迭代包住内层 BTGSB 小迭代](assets/3l5s-nested-loop.png)

项目地址：<https://github.com/rv198-star/Mindthus>

三层是：

- `Discovery`：现在到底发生了什么。
- `Definition`：应该把问题定义成什么。
- `Resolution`：如何把问题拆成可执行方案。

五步是 `BTGSB`：

- `Baseline`：当前基线是什么。
- `Target`：目标状态是什么。
- `Gap`：差距在哪里。
- `Strategy`：用什么策略跨过差距。
- `Breakdown`：拆成哪些可验证的任务。

它的重点不是把表格填满，而是避免 agent 和人类一样犯一个基本错误：问题还没定义清楚，就开始堆方案。

## 解决什么问题

3L5S 主要解决两类问题。

第一类是“现象很多，但问题不清”。例如用户说系统不好用、文档太干、任务总失败、agent 一直跑偏。这里真正的问题可能在目标、约束、事实、执行路径、验收标准或控制边界上。直接进入方案，会把症状当成根因。

第二类是“问题清楚，但太大”。例如已经知道要写中文说明书、重构技能包、跑长任务验证，但这个目标还不能直接执行。此时 3L5S 用 `Baseline -> Target -> Gap -> Strategy -> Breakdown` 把它拆成可以排期、可以验证、可以回退的行动。

它尤其适合 agent 工作流，因为 agent 很容易被局部 prompt、文件、测试失败或用户反馈牵着走。3L5S 会强制区分观察、定义和执行，避免把这三件事混成一句“我再改一下”。

## 核心判断

3L5S 的核心判断是：先判断你处在哪一层，再决定要不要拆任务。

如果连发生了什么都不清楚，先停在 `Discovery`。如果现象清楚但问题定义仍不稳，进入 `Definition`。只有当问题已经可复述、可定位、可证伪时，才进入 `Resolution`。

进入 `Resolution` 后，BTGSB 的价值在于让方案不再漂浮：

- 没有 `Baseline`，就不知道从哪里出发。
- 没有 `Target`，就不知道什么叫完成。
- 没有 `Gap`，策略会变成泛泛建议。
- 没有 `Strategy`，任务拆解会变成随机待办。
- 没有 `Breakdown`，方案仍然不可执行。

因此，3L5S 不是复杂模板，而是防止问题处理过早跳层的最小结构。

## 怎么用

先判断要用轻量版还是完整三层。

如果问题已经被用户明确定义，只需要执行拆解，用 `Single-layer BTGSB`：

1. 写出当前基线。
2. 写出目标状态。
3. 写出关键差距。
4. 选一个策略。
5. 拆成可验证任务。

如果用户输入里混着抱怨、现象、假设和目标，用 `Three-layer 3L5S`：

1. `Discovery`：收集可观察信号，不急着解释。
2. `Definition`：把问题压成一句可以被反驳的话。
3. `Resolution`：用 BTGSB 拆执行。

一个实用标准是：如果你不能用一句话说清“我们现在要解决的不是 X，而是 Y”，通常还不该进入方案阶段。

## 具体案例

### 案例 A：用户说“系统不好用”

不要立刻进入 Resolution 改界面或加功能。先做 `Discovery`：用户真正不满意的是入口太深、流程太长、报错不清，还是关键动作找不到？再做 `Definition`：问题可能不是“系统功能不够”，而是“新用户第一次完成核心任务的路径太不稳定”。

定义清楚后再进入 BTGSB：当前基线是用户需要 8 步完成任务，目标是 3 步内完成，差距是入口、提示和错误恢复，策略是先修核心路径，最后拆成导航调整、提示文案、错误状态和验证任务。

### 案例 B：测试失败但原因不明

如果只看到 `unittest` 失败，不要直接改代码。先在 `Discovery` 中收集失败测试、报错、最近 diff 和复现条件；再在 `Definition` 中判断问题是行为回归、测试契约变化，还是文档措辞不匹配。

只有当问题能被一句话复述时，才进入 `Resolution`。否则继续改代码，往往只是把一个未知问题变成多个未知问题。

## 常见误用

第一种误用，是把 3L5S 当成固定表格。结构很完整，但每一格都是空话，这比不写结构还危险，因为它制造了“已经想清楚”的错觉。

第二种误用，是跳过 Definition。很多执行失败不是因为任务拆得不细，而是根本拆错了对象。此时继续加任务只会扩大返工。

第三种误用，是在低风险、问题已经明确的场景里强行跑完整三层。3L5S 的价值是降低判断成本，不是制造仪式感。

## 边界

3L5S 不替代领域证据、运行时验证或 stakeholder 判断。它能把问题说清楚，但不能凭空决定事实。

如果真正卡住的是“谁应该控制这段工作”，用 `WAE`。如果卡住的是“长期方向和局部优势怎么取舍”，用 `SELA`。如果卡住的是“A/B 命题结构都不稳”，用 `EDSP`。

当问题已经小到可以直接执行，不要为了形式继续拆。一个清楚的下一步，有时比完整三层更有价值。

## 与其他方法的关系

- `using-mindthus` 在 3L5S 前做前置校准，去掉二手概念。
- `SRA` 在多个已达到最低可判断程度的问题或任务争夺同一稀缺资源时决定当前分配；3L5S 负责让候选可判断并落实选定工作。
- `EDSP` 处理 3L5S 里模糊的结构判断。
- `WAE` 处理 3L5S 产物里的控制边界。
- `TVG` 用在 3L5S 产物已经成型但仍然偏薄时。
- `tplan` 可以把 3L5S 拆出的任务放进 Mission runtime。

## 导航

- 返回 [README](../../README.md)
- 查看 [3L5S skill](../../skills/3l5s/SKILL.md)

# EDSP / Extreme Deduction + Scenario Projection

## 这是什么

EDSP 是 `Extreme Deduction + Scenario Projection`，一套用于定性结构判断的方法。

它适合处理那种“怎么说都像有道理”的问题：A 和 B 都对，边界不清，原则在具体场景里摇摆，或者命题本身可能就是错的。EDSP 不急着给答案，而是先把关键变量推到极端，建立一个稳定的结构坐标系，再把现实场景投进去看。

`Extreme Deduction` 负责把模糊命题压成结构；`Scenario Projection` 负责在结构稳定后处理具体场景。两者顺序很重要：如果坐标系还没建好，场景投影只会把直觉包装得更漂亮。

## 解决什么问题

EDSP 解决的是结构判断里的犹豫和伪二选一。

常见场景包括：

- A/B 都像对，但争论一直停留在偏好层。
- 问题被写成二选一，但真实结构可能不是二选一。
- 某个原则看似正确，但落到不同场景时结论相反。
- 一个命题听起来合理，却可能把变量混在一起。
- 趋势判断、伦理边界、产品取舍或工程原则需要更清楚的坐标系。

它对 agent 特别有用，因为 agent 很容易把双方理由都讲得通顺，然后停在“取决于上下文”。EDSP 要求先定义上下文的结构，而不是把“看情况”当结论。

## 核心判断

EDSP 的核心判断是：先推极端，再读结构；先定坐标，再投场景。

在 `Extreme Deduction` 中，先找关键变量，然后把它们推到极端。极端不是为了制造夸张，而是为了让变量的真实作用显形。例如把成本推到接近零，把延迟推到接近无限，把错误代价推到不可逆，把用户规模推到很大，原本模糊的判断往往会显出几种离散结构。

当结构坐标稳定后，才进入 `Scenario Projection`。这时具体场景不再是散乱例子，而是被投到坐标系中的点。你可以看它靠近哪个边界、受哪个变量主导、需要哪类证据才能继续判断。

EDSP 的关键成果不一定是一个答案，而是一个更好的问题形状。

## 怎么用

一个轻量 EDSP 可以这样做：

1. 写出原命题，尤其是那个让人摇摆的判断。
2. 找出 2-4 个关键变量，不要一上来列十几个因素。
3. 把每个变量推到极端，看结论是否反转。
4. 合并极端结果，形成少量结构坐标。
5. 用单 Agent 多角色做一次骨架挑战：`Builder` 建坐标，`Challenger` 专门挑错，`Synthesizer` 决定保留、重建或停止。
6. 判断现实场景更靠近哪个坐标区域。
7. 只有坐标稳定后，才给出场景建议。

例如一个判断如果在“小规模、低风险、可逆”时成立，但在“大规模、高风险、不可逆”时反转，那么问题的关键可能不是 A/B 谁更好，而是规模、风险和可逆性在控制结论。

输出可以很短：`结构变量 -> 极端推演 -> 坐标系 -> 当前场景落点 -> 建议动作`。

默认不拆成多个 Agent。单 Agent 多角色已经能降低“自己建骨架、自己证明骨架正确”的自洽风险；真正高影响或长期方向判断，才考虑升级成多个 Agent 对抗。

## 具体案例

### 案例 A：所有任务都要不要上 tplan

表面命题是“要不要所有任务都用 tplan”。直接回答很容易摇摆：用 tplan 更稳，但也更重。EDSP 会把变量推到极端：如果任务只有 10 分钟、单文件、低风险，tplan 成本明显过高；如果任务跨多天、多文件、多次决策、证据容易混乱，不上 tplan 的漂移风险很高。

这样坐标就出来了：任务长度、状态漂移风险、证据复杂度、回退代价在控制结论。现实场景落在哪个区域，决定是直接执行、轻量 checklist，还是启用完整 Mission runtime。

### 案例 B：自动化 review 还是人工 review

这看似是二选一：自动化更快，人工更稳。EDSP 会把两端推到极端：如果所有 review 都自动化，低风险格式问题处理很快，但高风险语义判断可能被误放行；如果所有 review 都人工处理，质量边界更稳，但低价值重复检查会拖慢整体节奏。

坐标稳定后，场景投影会得到更好的问题：哪些 claim 适合脚本检查，哪些判断必须人工或 agent 审查，哪些结论需要 evidence。这样比抽象争论“自动化好还是人工好”更可执行。

## 常见误用

最常见的误用，是把 EDSP 当作证据替代品。结构判断能告诉你应该看哪些变量，不能替你证明事实已经成立。

第二种误用，是先做 Scenario Projection，再回头补 Extreme Deduction。这样容易把自己已有偏好投射到场景里，看起来很细，实际坐标不稳。

第三种误用，是把漂亮的二维矩阵当成答案。坐标系只是为了减少混乱，如果变量选错、极端推演不成立，矩阵越漂亮越危险。

## 边界

EDSP 不替代领域研究、运行时证明、用户访谈、法律判断或 stakeholder 决策。如果真正缺的是事实，就先补事实。

它也不适合低不确定性任务。确定性的格式化、安装、测试、机械重构，不需要用 EDSP 包装。

如果问题卡在“怎么拆执行”，转 `3L5S`。如果卡在“谁控制这段工作”，转 `WAE`。如果卡在“长期系统效率是否压过局部优势”，转 `SELA`。如果候选结构已经稳定，真正的问题是多个有效行动争夺同一稀缺资源，转 `SRA` 做分配。

## 与其他方法的关系

- `3L5S` 提供问题处理主干，EDSP 处理其中的结构摇摆。
- `SELA` 可以借 EDSP 判断局部优势和系统效率的变量边界。
- `WAE` 约束 EDSP 输出应该由判断、流程还是证据接管。
- `SRA` 接收 EDSP 稳定后的候选结构，只负责跨候选资源分配；EDSP 不替代分配判断。
- `tplan` 可以把 EDSP 变成 Mission 中的 decision hook。

## 导航

- 返回 [README](../../README.md)
- 查看 [EDSP skill](../../skills/edsp/SKILL.md)

# SRA / Scarce Resource Allocation / 稀缺资源优先分配

## 这是什么

SRA 用来解决一个很直接的问题：

> 时间、人力、资金和注意力都有限，当前到底先把资源投到哪里？

它适用于多个事项都值得做，但无法同时获得同一批稀缺资源的情况。SRA 不只生成一个
`A > B > C` 的排序，还会判断：

- 哪些事项共同构成达标所需的最小组合；
- 哪些小事项会改变方向、解除瓶颈或避免不可逆损失；
- 哪些工作只需要维持最低维护线；
- 哪些正确的事现在必须延后或停止；
- 是否应该保留一部分资源作为机动量；
- 资源、证据、风险或时间窗口变化后，何时重新判断。

一句话：

> **以足够低的判断成本，先保护目标成立所必需的投入，再把下一份资源分给当前风险调整后边际价值最高的用途。**

项目地址：<https://github.com/rv198-star/Mindthus>

## 解决什么问题

很多资源浪费并不是因为正在做的事情完全没价值，而是因为它仍然“可以继续变好”。

例如一个页面已经达到上线门槛，动画还能继续优化；但支付链路尚未验证。继续做动画并不错误，
只是它已经不再决定本轮目标能否成立。如果没有一次明确的资源判断，当前任务会因为已经打开、
已经投入、继续起来最顺手，而不断获得更多时间。

SRA 处理的就是这种竞争：

- 当前任务继续做，还是切到更关键的任务；
- 新发现的问题现在修，还是记入后续；
- 多个产品问题谁进入当前 Sprint；
- 故障、合规、技术债和新功能怎样争夺团队资源；
- 现金有限时，完整建设和方向验证之间如何取舍；
- 一个人同时承担多个长期项目时，哪些主攻、保底或停止。

SRA 的判断中心不是“哪个任务听起来更重要”，而是：

> 哪些候选真正竞争同一种有限资源，它们如何影响同一个目标门槛，当前下一批资源投到哪里最合理。

## 核心判断

主路径只有三步：

1. **保住目标成立的必要投入**：先明确目标、时间范围、权限和不可突破的风险底线，再找出足够支撑目标的最小可行投入。
2. **把新增资源投到最值得的地方**：在可行用途之间，比较下一份有意义投入的风险调整后边际价值。方向验证、瓶颈、窗口和信息只是价值来源，不是天然更高的优先级标签。
3. **不为填满资源而投入**：保留有理由的维护与机动量，明确延后或停止，并说明何时重新排序。

“先生存、再图强”不把原本目标偷偷降低为勉强生存，也不让必要项无限占用资源。收益不只指短期财务回报：维护、学习、照护、长期能力和选择权可以有重要价值；难量化和未知都不等于零。安全、尊严和已承诺的责任先界定可行范围，不能靠较高收益比买断。SRA 比较任务投入，不评价人的价值。

排序本身也消耗资源。只继续那些有望改变当前行动、且收益超过成本的分析；一个操作只需几秒，并不代表其错误后果很小。

## 两档使用方式

SRA 默认轻量运行。只有错误分配可能造成较大损失时，才展开完整分析。两档共享同一个
“收缩—回补”核心：Lite 只做一次微型收缩和一次微型回补，Full 才把它展开到多个组合、
多种资源和相邻压力场景。

### Lite：快速优先级决策

Lite 用于普通执行过程中的下一步判断。

它只回答：

> 下一份有意义的资源，是继续投在当前任务，还是切换、保底、延后、停止或保留？

Lite 通常只比较：

- 当前路径；
- 最强的可信替代项；
- 维护、延后、停止和保留资源。

它先做一次**微型收缩**：当前投入可以删减、封顶或降到什么程度，仍然守住目标门槛和风险底线；
再做一次**微型回补**：从这个当前底座出发，下一批资源投给当前路径、最强替代项还是保留，哪一个最能改变结果。

输出可以很短：

```text
当前决定：切换到支付验证
为什么现在：支付仍阻塞上线，动画只提高完成度
当前底座：页面只维持上线阻断缺陷修复
下一投入批次：一个工程师日，产出可复现的支付验证结果
当前投入上限：到本次验证检查点为止
延后或停止：动画优化延后，页面仅修上线阻断缺陷
重排触发：支付验证通过、出现新阻塞，或页面发生上线阻断问题
```

Lite 只授权一个动作、一个资源批次，或到一个明确检查点。它不会因为一次快速判断，自动批准当前路径长期持续投入。

### Full：完整资源分配

Full 用于项目、Mission、产品组合或重大执行调整，例如：

- 多个可行组合争夺同一周期；
- 多种资源同时受限；
- 投入有固定门槛，少量投入不会产生价值；
- 方向性未知可能使大量后续工作失效；
- 决策金额大、影响广、难以回退；
- 需要形成主攻、支撑、维护、延后、停止和机动资源的完整方案。

Full 会完成：

1. 锁定目标、门槛、时间窗、风险底线和决策责任人；
2. 找出真正竞争的资源和当前主导约束；
3. 让候选达到最低可比程度；
4. 处理可能改变方向的关键未知；
5. 构造一个或多个当前最小充分组合；
6. 淘汰不可行和被其他组合全面支配的方案；
7. 运行资源收缩，找到不可删项和失败边界；
8. 运行资源回补，判断下一批资源加在哪里；
9. 形成当前分配和机动资源；
10. 设置决策有效期与重新排序条件。

## 上下文校准的混合运行

SRA 要独立于既有结论的权威，但不能脱离当前决策需要的真实上下文。它保留目标、用户约束、
权限、证据、假设和执行状态，同时把旧结论、候选宣传、环境推断和沉没成本叙事放回正确层级。

候选只做**结构对齐**：字段一致、来源清楚、引用可追溯；真实证据强弱不被抹平。输入也不能先把
候选标成“必要项”“高价值项”或“低优先级”，这些角色必须由 SRA Agentic 判断产生。

普通对话中的 Lite 可以直接给一段有边界的建议，无需建立运行档案；它不会因此获得执行权限。正式资源分配使用同一套运行时合同。

旧运行保持原有策略：普通低风险 Lite 可单视图，Full 或污染场景采用双视图。新输入可显式采用 `sra.proportionate.v1`：Lite/Full 由分析深度决定，单双视图由后果与污染决定。仅结构复杂、且已明确评估为低后果可逆时，Full 可以单视图；高后果、风险未知、既有结论或沉没成本压力仍用双视图。缺权限应补权限，额外模型不能代替批准。

双视图采用两个互不可见的视角：

- **去锚定挑战**：不知道哪个候选正在执行，也不看历史投入和切换状态，检查当前路径是否只是因
  已经开始、描述更丰富或曾被推荐而继续获得资源；
- **情境化判断**：保留真实切换成本、可复用资产、剩余成本、当前承诺和权限，独立给出可执行分配；
  它看不到去锚定挑战的结论。

脚本只比较两份判断的结构化结果，不替它们选赢家：

```text
一致 → 以情境化判断形成最终分配，去锚定视角作为反偏差佐证
冲突 → 仅围绕冲突字段生成一次定向协调
证据仍不足 → conditional / blocked / request_missing_context
```

重大或候选覆盖存疑的场景可以先做 Packet Coverage Review，但该 Reviewer 只检查是否漏掉关键
候选、证据或风险，不得顺手决定优先级。新子 Agent 或临时 CLI 是可选的只读承载器；真正的独立性
来自上下文分层、两份判断互不可见、证据绑定和冲突协调，而不是“开了新上下文”本身。

这套运行用于约束叙事污染和盲评锚定；合同通过不能证明候选已经穷尽，也不能保证最终优先级一定正确。单视图不能被展示为独立佐证。

## Candidate Horizon Probe / 候选视野探针

SRA 在决定优先级前，会短暂检查当前视野是否被正在做的任务占据。

至少扫过：

1. 当前路径；
2. 硬 Gate、阻塞项或达标前置项；
3. 会改变方向的未知、不可逆风险或正在关闭的机会窗口；
4. 对同一目标最强的可行替代项；
5. 保底、保留、延后和停止选项。

这不是要求全面盘点所有任务。它只防止 Agent 在 A 和随手想到的 B 之间认真比较，却漏掉真正关键的 C。

## Current Minimum Sufficient Bundle / 当前最小充分组合

SRA 寻找的不是“最小任务”，而是当前证据下能够使目标成立的一组行动。

一个组合在以下条件下可以称为当前充分：

- 在明确的时间窗和风险底线内，足以支持达到目标门槛；
- 删除其中任一不可替代部分后，达标判断不再受到充分支持；
- 不包含只改善观感或形式完整性、却不影响目标、风险、证据或必要可选性的投入。

“最小”不等于脆弱。备份、回滚、复核和冗余在风险底线要求时，也可能是必要项。

如果当前资源下没有任何组合能够达到目标，正确输出是：

```text
当前无可行组合
```

然后说明缺少什么资源、哪个门槛造成不可行，以及什么变化能够恢复可行。不能为了给出答案而偷偷降低目标。

## 资源收缩—回补循环

Lite 用一次微型收缩和一次微型回补完成下一批资源判断；Full 对多个可信组合反复施加现实压力，
直到找到当前底座、失败边界和下一批投入。轻量模式减少分析宽度，不省略方法核心。

### 收缩

在保持目标门槛和风险底线不变的前提下，逐步收紧真实的受限资源：

- 哪些行动仍然不能删；
- 哪些可以替换、合并、并行或降级；
- 删除什么会改变方向或阻塞多项后续；
- 哪些投入只是在达标之后继续提高完成度；
- 哪种资源最先使组合失效。

### 回补

从最低可行组合开始，逐步加回下一份能够产生结果的资源：

- 哪一批投入解除当前瓶颈；
- 哪一批投入打开最多后续选项；
- 哪一批投入提供最高的信息价值；
- 哪一批投入保护最重要的时间窗口；
- 哪一批投入最能提高目标相关结果。

一句话：

> 收缩找出不能删的；回补决定下一份值得加的。

如果收缩和回补顺序冲突，通常存在依赖、组合效应、固定投入门槛、切换成本或未解决的不确定性。此时保留条件式或局部顺序，不强行生成虚假排名。

## 不同资源不能简单相加

时间、资金、工程师、法务、管理注意力、风险额度和机会窗口并不总能互换。

SRA 会先判断：

- 当前真正受限的是哪一类资源；
- 哪些候选确实竞争同一资源池；
- 哪些工作可以使用不同资源并行推进；
- 哪些任务需要不可分割的投入门槛。

因此，它不要求把所有因素压成一个统一分数。

## 切换成本与沉没成本

执行中的重排需要区分：

- **沉没成本**：已经花掉且无法收回，不能成为继续投入的理由；
- **切换成本**：从当前状态转向另一条路径需要新增的真实成本；
- **可复用资产**：已经完成、未来仍然有价值的工作；
- **剩余成本**：从现在开始完成当前路径还需要多少资源。

判断比较的是从当前状态开始的未来后果，而不是两条路径历史累计投入谁更多。

## 什么时候不用

以下情况直接处理更好：

- 只有一个明确阻塞项；
- 没有真实的共同资源竞争；
- 不同任务使用独立资源，可以并行；
- 选择低风险、可逆，尝试成本低于分析成本；
- 只是按既定顺序执行的简单清单。

SRA 的目标是降低错误分配成本，不是给每个待办增加一套仪式。

## 与其他方法的关系

| 方法 | 拥有的判断 | 与 SRA 的关系 |
|---|---|---|
| `3L5S` | 问题发现、定义和拆解 | 让候选达到最低可判断程度；SRA 决定哪些获得资源 |
| `EDSP` | 命题结构、伪二选一和判断坐标 | 为可能改变分配的结构未知提供约束 |
| `SELA` | 系统效率与局部优势的长期方向 | 提供方向约束；SRA 决定当前资源配置 |
| `MPG` | 一个已选主线的载体、暴露和路径承载 | SRA 选跨候选资源；MPG 设计单一主线如何穿越路径 |
| `WAE` | Agentic system 的 Workflow / Agentic / Evidence 控制边界 | 只在 SRA 运行方式存在控制者错配时介入 |
| `TVG` | 单个有界产物的下一轮价值增益 | 产物内部由 TVG 判断；产物与外部任务争资源时由 SRA 判断 |
| `Anti-Spiral` | 发现局部修补正在替代目标推进 | Anti-Spiral 刹车，SRA 决定释放的资源去哪里 |
| `TPlan` | Mission 状态、证据、权限、恢复和任务变更 | TPlan 记录和执行；SRA 只提供真实资源竞争下的语义判断 |

尤其要区分：

```text
多个问题、任务或行动组合争夺公共资源 → SRA
一个已选主线需要选择载体、暴露和穿越路径 → MPG
```

TPlan 的 Pulse 仲裁、Mission 重入、同路径继续授权和任务变更权仍然属于 TPlan，不由 SRA 接管。

## 证据边界

SRA 可以让资源分配变得：

- 更显式；
- 更容易审查；
- 更不容易被当前细节绑架；
- 能明确产生延后和停止清单；
- 能设置资源上限与重排条件。

它不能仅凭一套完整结构证明：

- 这一定是正确优先级；
- 这个方案一定最大化 ROI；
- 当前组合是数学最优解；
- 压力测试通过就等于真实业务价值已经被证明。

脚本可以管理上下文准入、候选结构对齐、包与判断哈希、阶段顺序、引用检查和结果渲染；
它不能替人或 Agent 判断真实必要性、组合充分性、语义 ROI 或正确优先级。

## 导航

- 返回 [README](../../README.md)
- 查看 [SRA skill](../../skills/sra/SKILL.md)
- 查看 [SRA 完整方法资源](../../skills/sra/resources/methodology.md)
- 查看 [SRA 上下文隔离运行合同](../../skills/sra/resources/context-isolation.md)

skills/3l5s/SKILL.md.content:
---
name: "3l5s"
description: Use when a problem is unclear, noisy, repeatedly reworked, or too large to execute directly; also use when a task list looks structured but may not be executable, verifiable, or tied to a falsifiable problem.
---

# 3L5S

## Core Claim / 核心判断

`3L5S` means:

> `Three Layers + Five Steps`
>
> `三层五步`

The three layers are:

> `Discovery -> Definition -> Resolution`

The five steps are the BTGSB operator:

> `Baseline -> Target -> Gap -> Strategy -> Breakdown`

Chinese mnemonic:

> `基 -> 标 -> 差 -> 策 -> 拆`

3L5S is a general-purpose problem-processing kernel. It is not a stage-specific checklist.

It has two main use cases:

1. Discover and define the real problem when phenomena are noisy, signals are scattered, and root cause is unclear.
2. When the problem is already clear but too large or complex to execute directly, decompose it into executable, schedulable, verifiable tasks.

一句话：

> 不清楚问题时，先把信号变成可证伪的问题；问题太大时，再把问题变成可验证的行动。

It has two valid forms:

- `Single-layer BTGSB`: use the five-step landing method directly.
- `Three-layer BTGSB`: run BTGSB across `Discovery`, `Definition`, and `Resolution` when signal, problem, and action are not yet separable.

## Mainline / 主路径

### Choose The Form / 选择形态

Use `Single-layer BTGSB` when the problem is already accepted enough to solve.

Use `Three-layer 3L5S` when the agent may be collapsing observation, definition, and resolution into one answer.

Do not force three layers onto every task. The method's value comes from preventing layer collapse, not from maximizing ceremony.

### Main Use Cases / 主用法

#### 1. Discover And Define Problems

Use 3L5S when the real problem is not yet clear. The discovery and definition layers turn abnormal world signals into a problem that can be restated, located, and falsified:

- `Discovery`: locate and stabilize the signal
- `Definition`: turn signal into a falsifiable problem
- `Resolution`: turn accepted problem into action

This prevents the agent from treating symptoms as problems or jumping from weak signal to solution.

#### 2. Decompose And Land Known Problems

Use the resolution layer and the five-step BTGSB operator when the problem is already clear but too large, complex, or non-executable:

- clarify current state and target state
- name the gap
- choose the strategy
- break the problem into executable, schedulable, verifiable tasks

This is especially valuable in problem-solving work: it keeps complex problems from becoming vague task lists.

### Single-Layer BTGSB

Single-layer BTGSB is not a weaker version of the method. It is the most practical form when the active work is already in the problem-solving or resolution stage.

Use it when:

- the signal and problem are clear enough
- the main need is to turn a vague problem into executable work
- the current state and target state both need to be named
- the gap, strategy, or next action is still fuzzy
- a plan contains non-executable verbs like `improve`, `optimize`, `research`, or `handle`

It is especially valuable in resolution work because it keeps the agent from jumping from problem statement to task list without naming the gap, strategy, acceptance evidence, and next executable action.

Flow:

1. `Baseline`: what is true now?
2. `Target`: what state counts as arrival?
3. `Gap`: what is missing between baseline and target?
4. `Strategy`: which path crosses the gap, and why this path?
5. `Breakdown`: what can start next, with acceptance evidence?

If a breakdown item cannot start, run BTGSB again on that child problem.

### Three-Layer BTGSB

Three-layer BTGSB is the epistemic expansion of the same method. Use it when observation, definition, and resolution may be collapsed into one confident but premature answer.

Layers:

- `Discovery`: world -> signal
- `Definition`: signal -> problem
- `Resolution`: problem -> action

Use it when:

- a problem starts from noisy observations, user reports, logs, or partial evidence
- the signal may not be reproducible yet
- the problem statement may still be unfalsifiable
- the work is jumping from symptom to solution
- execution feedback is surprising and may require looping back

Short rule:

> Discover until the signal is real, define until the problem is falsifiable, resolve until the action is verifiable.

## Guardrails / 从属补漏

### Default Use In Work Items / 工单默认姿态

- If the problem is unclear: do not start by fixing; use 3L5S to define the problem first.
- If the problem is too large: do not start by doing; use the 5S operator to break it into tasks first.
- If execution repeatedly loops or reworks: return to `Baseline -> Target -> Gap -> Strategy -> Breakdown` and check whether problem definition or task decomposition failed to close.
- If two failed prompt rules, fallback branches, or local patches are followed by a request to add a third, brake before adding: restate the upstream problem, find the instability/root-cause evidence, and prefer deletion or equal replacement. Clear failing tests with new evidence can continue as ordinary debugging.

### Script Assistance Boundary / 脚本辅助边界

3L5S can be supported by lightweight scripts, but scripts must protect judgment rather than replace it.

Scripts may:

- initialize a single-layer or three-layer working draft
- check whether required sections are present
- flag vague action verbs, missing evidence, missing acceptance criteria, and missing next actions
- surface possible layer collapse, such as solution language appearing inside Discovery
- record assumptions, unresolved questions, rejected alternatives, and loopback reasons

Scripts must not:

- decide whether a signal is important
- decide whether a root cause is true
- choose the strategy under uncertainty
- treat a complete template as proof of a correct judgment
- erase meaningful ambiguity by forcing every concern into a field

Script reports should be read as `Shape & Evidence Risk Reports`, not as truth validation.

Full boundary: `resources/script-boundary.md`.

### Relationship To Other Mindthus Skills

- Use `sra` when multiple sufficiently defined problems or tasks compete for the same scarce resource; 3L5S makes candidates judgeable, SRA allocates them.
- Use `edsp` when a 3L5S `Gap` or `Strategy` contains a fuzzy structural choice.
- Use `wae` when deciding whether a 3L5S step should be controlled by workflow, agentic judgment, evidence, or a combination.
- Use `tvg` after a bounded 3L5S output exists but may still be thin in practical value.

## Boundaries / 边界

- 3L5S must not become ceremony; use single-layer BTGSB when the problem is already clear.
- Do not treat a complete template, script pass, or checklist pass as proof that the judgment is true.
- Do not use 3L5S to replace domain evidence, runtime verification, or stakeholder judgment.

## Runtime Support / 支撑材料

### Resource Files

- `resources/landing-method.md` — full single-layer BTGSB landing method.
- `resources/three-layer-recursive-loop.md` — full three-layer BTGSB recursive loop.
- `resources/script-boundary.md` — WAE-based boundary for script assistance.
- `resources/fidelity-contract.md` — 3L5S fidelity contract for v0.9.

### Templates And Scripts

- `templates/single-layer-btgsb.md` — working draft for known-problem landing work.
- `templates/three-layer-3l5s.md` — working draft for signal/problem/action separation.
- `templates/loopback-record.md` — record surprising feedback and why the analysis loops back.
- `templates/fidelity-output.json` — example v0.9 fidelity output shape.
- `scripts/init_3l5s_run.py` — generate a draft from a template.
- `scripts/check_3l5s_run.py` — produce a shape and evidence risk report.
- `scripts/validate_3l5s_output.py` — validate fidelity contract output shape with the shared core.

skills/edsp/SKILL.md.content:
---
name: edsp
description: "Use when an ambiguous qualitative judgment needs Extreme Deduction and optional Scenario Projection: push variables to extremes, build a structural coordinate system, diagnose malformed propositions, then project concrete scenarios when needed."
---

# EDSP / Extreme Deduction + Scenario Projection

## Core Claim

`EDSP` means:

> `Extreme Deduction + Scenario Projection`
>
> `极限推演 + 场景投影`

Extreme Deduction is the core method. It turns fuzzy continuous ambiguity into a discrete structural coordinate system by pushing key variables to extremes, collapsing possible outcomes, and reading real-world drift.

Short rule:

> 极限推演先建骨架；场景投影只是补充用法。

Scenario Projection remains available as a supplement when a concrete scenario must be placed inside the coordinate system built by Extreme Deduction.

## Mainline / 主路径

### When To Use

Use this skill when facing questions like:

- `A also seems right, B also seems right; which is actually better?`
- `Is this a real binary choice, or is the question malformed?`
- `Should this be decided structurally, or by scenario boundary?`
- `Which option is becoming the natural mainline under current drift?`

Do not use it to replace evidence acquisition, domain research, runtime proof, or stakeholder judgment when those are the actual missing inputs.
When a prompt forces A/B but the dimensions or risk boundaries are unstable, the first
sentence must diagnose the malformed binary and withhold a winner. Do not name a
provisional winner merely because the user says to choose first; any conservative
operating default follows the structural diagnosis and is not the answer to which side
is right.
When the prompt asks who is right for an active buy/use/commit decision, first name
which frame owns that current decision. Do not open with a balanced "both sides are
right" abstraction unless the user's value tradeoff truly owns the choice.

### Operating Flow

1. Ask whether the active uncertainty is structural or scenario-specific.
2. If structural, run `Extreme Deduction`:
   - decompose driving variables
   - push variables to extremes
   - collapse outcomes into discrete poles
   - read real-world drift
   - produce positioning or diagnose a malformed proposition
3. Run the `Multi-Role Challenge` inside the same agent before accepting the L1 skeleton:
   - `Builder`: proposes the dimensions, extremes, collapsed outcomes, and drift prior
   - `Challenger`: attacks missed variables, duplicated dimensions, weak extremes, forced collapse, and biased drift reading
   - `Synthesizer`: keeps, rebuilds, or rejects the coordinate system
4. If Extreme Deduction creates a stable coordinate system and a concrete choice remains, run `Scenario Projection`.
5. Output the choice guidance, boundary conditions, and what evidence could overturn it.

## Guardrails / 从属补漏

### Stop Conditions

Stop after Extreme Deduction if the task only needs structural judgment, proposition diagnosis, trend identification, or a finding that the original binary is synthetic.

Run Scenario Projection only when a concrete scenario must be selected inside a stable Extreme Deduction coordinate system.

### Multi-Role Challenge

Use `single-agent multi-role` pressure by default for non-trivial EDSP runs. The
point is not theatrics; it protects L1 from a clean but wrong skeleton.

Boundary: do not run Scenario Projection if `Challenger` finds a missed decisive variable,
duplicated dimension, under-pushed extreme, forced outcome collapse, or biased drift
reading. `Synthesizer` must rebuild L1 or state that EDSP cannot decide yet.

For very high-impact or long-term decisions, separate agents are an escalation option, not the default.

## Boundaries / 边界

- Do not use EDSP to replace evidence acquisition, domain research, runtime proof, or stakeholder judgment.
- Do not run Scenario Projection before Extreme Deduction has produced a stable coordinate system.
- If the output becomes elegant but does not improve a decision, treat the method use as failed.
- If candidate structure is already stable and several valid actions compete for one shared scarce resource, use SRA for allocation; EDSP only stabilizes a malformed proposition or comparison axis.

## Runtime Support / 支撑材料

Read `resources/methodology.md` when you need the detailed EDSP procedure, anti-patterns, or examples of coordinate-system failure.

- `resources/fidelity-contract.md` — EDSP fidelity contract for v0.9.
- `templates/fidelity-output.json` — example v0.9 fidelity output shape.
- `scripts/validate_edsp_output.py` — validate fidelity contract output shape with the shared core.

skills/sra/SKILL.md.content:
---
name: sra
description: "Use directly when multiple already-judgeable actions or bundles compete for one named scarce resource; choose the current floor and next meaningful tranche. Default Lite; use Full for explicit bundles, multiple resource constraints, fixed thresholds, or major commitments. Do not use with missing comparison facts/resource, or for one selected mainline's carrier, exposure, timing, or exit."
---

# SRA / Scarce Resource Allocation / 稀缺资源优先分配

## Core Claim

> 以足够低的判断成本，先保护目标成立所必需的投入，
> 再把下一份资源分给当前风险调整后边际价值最高的用途。

“先生存、再图强” means viability before optional improvement, under the user's real
goal, time horizon and protected constraints. SRA ranks work, not the worth of people.

Execution shorthand:

> 收缩找出不能删的；回补决定下一份值得加的。

SRA allocates a shared scarce resource among sufficiently judgeable work. It is an
evidence-bounded judgment, not a universal score or optimizer.

## Mainline

### Entry And Analysis-Cost Gate

Choose one entry outcome:

- `direct`: one required next action exists, no credible competing use of the same
  resource exists, or direct trial is cheaper than analysis;
- `lite`: one bounded action, resource tranche, or named checkpoint is enough;
- `full`: explicit candidate bundles, multiple constrained resources, fixed thresholds,
  direction-changing uncertainty, or a major/hard-to-reverse commitment is load-bearing;
- `blocked`: allocation would require inventing a target, authority, shared resource,
  candidate contribution, evidence, question projection, or risk boundary.

`auto` starts from Lite and expands only under named escalation conditions. It is a mode
selector, not a third reasoning mode.

Use a depth whose cost is lower than the plausible avoidable loss from a wrong allocation.
Stop when more analysis is unlikely to change the next action enough to repay its cost.
A seconds-long irreversible action can warrant more review than a long reversible task.

### Allocation Frame

Lock the smallest sufficient frame:

```text
parent_objective
target_threshold
time_window
risk_floor
decision_owner
resource_pools[]
evidence_ceiling
```

Each resource pool has a stable `resource_id`, a decision window, capacity, and one
quantity contract:

- `measured`: exact or bounded amount with additive `sum`;
- `ordinal`: one ordered level with `exclusive` allocation;
- `indivisible`: named blocks with block-set allocation.

Do not translate unlike resources into one synthetic score.

### Candidate Horizon Probe

Scan only far enough to avoid active-task capture:

1. current path;
2. hard gate, blocker, or threshold-essential predecessor;
3. direction-changing unknown, irreversible risk, or closing opportunity;
4. strongest feasible alternative serving the same objective;
5. maintenance, reserve, defer, and stop postures.

Lite normally keeps two to four actionable candidates. Full expands only when bundle or
resource-channel structure requires it.

Candidate cards carry observable action, effect, demand, dependency, window, downside,
reversibility, evidence, and assumptions. Inputs do not pre-label priority, ROI,
hard-gate status, necessity, or another SRA role.

### Priority Order

1. Protect the minimum sufficient support for the declared target, authority and risk
   floor. Test necessity by what would break if that support were removed.
2. Compare risk-adjusted bundle value and the marginal value of meaningful additional
   resource commitments among feasible alternatives. Dependencies constrain executable
   order; direction tests, bottlenecks and windows are sources of value, not automatic
   priority labels.
3. Commit only worthwhile tranches. Keep justified maintenance or reserve, and explicitly
   defer or stop displaced work. Reconsider when relevant evidence or resources change.

Compare fixed or indivisible thresholds as complete meaningful tranches. Unknown value is
not zero; delayed benefits, learning, care, reliability and options count under the chosen
horizon. No universal numeric ROI score or mandatory utilization target is required.

### Lite

Lite runs the shared method core once: lock the frame, probe candidates, run one
`micro-contraction` to expose the current floor, then one `micro-replenishment` to choose
the next meaningful tranche. Separate future switching cost from sunk cost and set the
ceiling, horizon, displaced-work posture, and rerank trigger.

Lite uses:

```text
one_action | one_tranche | until_named_checkpoint
```

A Lite result without both contraction and replenishment is ordinary prioritization, not
complete SRA fidelity.

### Full

Full expands the same logic across explicit bundles and resource channels. It records
bundle assessments, removes infeasible or dominated bundles, runs Resource Contraction
and Resource Replenishment, selects one feasible or conditional non-dominated bundle,
and records the ledger, tranche, reserve, ceiling, and authorization boundary.

Full may use `bounded_decision_window` in addition to Lite horizons. It must not merely
produce a longer Lite explanation: explicit bundle members and bundle assessments are
required.

### Allocation Ledger And Outcome

Every candidate receives exactly one posture in the current window:

```text
floor | maintenance | candidate | defer | stop
```

`floor` and `maintenance` carry nonzero current allocation. `candidate`, `defer`, and
`stop` carry zero. The next tranche is separate from current allocation.

`allocate` authorizes the typed tranche; `conditional` waits for its named condition;
`infeasible`, `blocked`, and `request_missing_context` authorize no target-reaching work.

### Stop

Lite stops after one bounded allocation and rerank trigger. Full stops when the selected
bundle is stable across adjacent realistic pressure, the first tranche is clear,
remaining uncertainty cannot change the current action, and another analysis round has
no named positive-value hypothesis.

## Guardrails

### Protect The Target Threshold

Keep the requested target and risk floor fixed during contraction. A cheaper survival
state becomes valid only through an explicit authorized target change. Necessary work
receives sufficient support, not unlimited investment. If resources cannot support the
floor, expose the infeasibility and the decision needed; do not silently lower the target.

### Preserve The Real Objective

This guardrail prevents short-term, measurable gains from replacing the user's goal.
Use the declared horizon and affected-party constraints; protect safety, dignity, care,
commitments and sustainable capacity where they bind the decision. High expected gain
cannot buy a breach of a hard boundary. Low-confidence benefits may justify a bounded
probe, not automatic rejection or unlimited speculative spending.

### Protect Small But Decisive Actions

Keep direction tests, bottleneck removal, irreversible-risk prevention, and option
creation visible. This does not make every small task critical.

### Judge Bundles Before Isolated Tasks

Preserve complementarity and fixed thresholds, then test every claimed member through
contraction. A weak component cannot hide inside a large bundle.

### Preserve Partial Orders

Dependency, parallel resources, threshold effects, and uncertainty may justify parallel
or conditional allocation. Do not force a total ranking.

### Separate Switching And Sunk Cost

Compare future consequences from the current state. Historical spend never proves that
continuation is best.

### Keep Workflow Deterministic

Workflow validates references, resource contracts, each candidate's cumulative current
plus next-tranche demand, bundle membership, posture consistency, capacity, ceilings,
state transitions, and typed disagreement. It
does not decide semantic necessity, risk acceptance, bundle sufficiency, strongest
alternative, or priority.

## Boundaries

- `3L5S` defines or decomposes candidates that are not yet judgeable.
- `EDSP` owns an unstable proposition, false binary, or structural coordinate system.
- `SELA` owns long-term system-efficiency versus local-advantage direction pressure.
- `MPG` owns carrier, exposure, timing, optionality, and path posture for one selected
  mainline.
- `WAE` owns an Agentic/Workflow/Evidence controller mismatch.
- `TVG` owns another value-gain round inside one bounded artifact.
- Anti-Spiral supplies the brake when repeated repair replaces objective progress; SRA
  allocates the released resource.
- `TPlan` owns Mission state, Pulse arbitration, continuation, recovery, authority, and
  mutation. SRA returns semantic allocation; it does not mutate the Mission.

Do not use SRA when there is no real shared resource contention. Do not treat the words
“priority”, “important”, “ROI”, or “resource” as sufficient wake-up evidence.

## Runtime Support

Conversational Lite may give bounded advice without creating a run. Controlled
allocations use the sole v0.3 contract and `prepare_sra_run.py`, `record_sra_judgment.py`,
`check_sra_run.py`, `repair_sra_run.py` and `render_sra_decision.py`.

Read `resources/proportionate-runtime.md` for draft intake, checked cards, completion
references and explicit re-ranking. Helpers generate structure, not facts or permission.
Legacy inputs retain conservative calibration; the named proportionate policy admits
single-view structural Full only after an explicit ordinary/reversible assessment.
Uncertain, consequential or contaminated cases retain mutually hidden dual views.

`run.json` is a cache. Raw input and Agentic judgments own the decision; Repair only
rebuilds derived artifacts. Changed inputs require a new run. Prepared v0.2 runs are not
resumed under v0.3. Detailed contracts live in `resources/context-isolation.md`.

Integrity checks prove neither complete context nor correct priority, optimal ROI or
real-world value. A short card is a projection of the checked decision, not new authority.

cognitive_obligations.context: Let the actual user/actor goal and acceptable tradeoffs control the situated judgment while facts still constrain it. Do not invent purchase timing or erase legitimate preferences.

route.load_order_meaning: Resource loading order only; execution_order is null when dependency observations conflict. Resolve the source-bound canonical prerequisite before acting, or disclose a bounded route objection.
route.uncertainty_instruction: Preserve supported work and identify missing facts or routing uncertainty locally. A named-method ambiguity is not a ban on responding. Genuine permissions and evidence limits remain binding.

payload.text:
现状是：80%为规则明确的常规申请，20%为有语义争议的申诉。目标是按时处理常规量，同时让争议进入人工处理。差距在于尚无经过验证的分流边界：全部自动会放行申诉，全部人工又无法按时处理常规量。极端推演后，可比较的组合是“规则明确的申请自动处理；申诉及分流不确定的申请转人工”。这确定了处理边界，但分流准确性和人工处理能力仍需验证。

本期6个人日先留出2个建设人工申诉转交入口，再用4个建设常规申请自动化。收缩任一部分，都会分别失去争议人工处理底线或常规量的时限支撑；回补的下一份资源因此投向这两个必要部分组成的完整组合。非必要报表美化需3个人日，本期延后。上线前应验证争议不会被自动放行、转交可用，并确认人工队列有足够处理能力；现有资料不足以宣称这些条件已经满足。
